joker: Joker is a Boxer Standard boxing machine from PRO-GAMES, decorated with playing cards and a grinning Bad Clown character. Players punch the bag to beat the high score – a captivating strength challenge that keeps customers coming back.
pow-boxer: POW Boxer brings comic-book pop art to the Boxer Standard collection, with bold POW! lettering on a yellow cabinet. Every punch is a test of strength that invites players to return and improve their result.
champion: Champion dresses the Boxer Standard cabinet in a title-fight theme: a championship belt, flames and stars-and-stripes graphics. Guests step up, hit the bag and try to beat the top score.
easy: Easy is the classic boxing design in the PRO-GAMES Boxer Standard range, with boxer silhouettes and bold BOXER lettering. The game is simple: strike the bag, check the score and play again to beat it.
cyber-punch: Cyber Punch gives the Boxer Standard machine a sci-fi look, with an armoured cyber fighter and GAME OVER artwork. Its strength-testing gameplay holds attention and brings players back for a rematch.
gladiator: Gladiator puts an arena warrior on the cabinet of this Boxer Standard boxing machine. Players test their punch against the scoreboard, and the race for the highest result keeps them coming back.
mma: MMA is a Boxer Standard boxing machine styled after mixed martial arts, with a fighter graphic in red and black. A hard punch, an instant score and the urge to beat it – a simple game that keeps customers playing.
black-jack: Black Jack brings a casino theme to the Boxer Standard collection: card suits, playing cards and dice cover the cabinet. Behind the theme is the proven PRO-GAMES boxing game – punch the bag, read the score, try again.
super-hero: Super Hero decorates the Boxer Standard boxer with a caped comic-book hero and colourful comic panels. Players punch the bag to prove their strength and return to improve their score.
power-black: Power Black is the darkest design in the Boxer Standard collection: a black cabinet with a monochrome muscular fighter. It offers the same engaging strength challenge that keeps players coming back for another round.
poison-squad: Poison Squad covers the Boxer Standard cabinet in toxic green, with a gas-mask soldier at its centre. One strike at the bag shows the score – and an invitation to try again and beat it.
hacker: Hacker gives this Boxer Standard boxing machine a cyber look: a hooded hacker framed by neon lines. The gameplay stays classic – punch, score and come back to beat the result.
strongman: Strongman is a Boxer Standard design built around a muscle-bound strongman character on a yellow cabinet. It invites players to measure their punch, compare scores and come back for more.
viking: Viking shows a horned-helmet warrior on a blue cabinet in the Boxer Standard collection. Players take on the punching bag and return to improve their result.
disco: Disco brings a club look to the Boxer Standard range, with a party graphic and neon DISCO lettering. Guests test their punch and compete for the highest score.
boxer-combat: Boxer Combat is a premium PRO-GAMES boxing machine with a red cabinet framed by LED lights and BOXING FIGHT TONIGHT graphics. Its strength-testing gameplay keeps players competing and coming back for more.
boxer-ring: Boxer Ring is a premium boxing machine with a round score display on a column-style red cabinet. Players punch the bag to beat the best result, which keeps them engaged and returning.
monster-3in1-ticket: Monster 3 in 1 Ticket is the ticket version of the PRO-GAMES Monster family: boxing, kicking and a hammer strike in a single machine.

Players choose between punching, kicking and hammering in one durable, eye-catching cabinet with LED lighting and high-quality sensors for accurate scoring. The compact 3-in-1 format suits bars, amusement centres and events where space matters. Sales confirms the ticket system and equipment for your venue.
double-strike: Double Strike 2 combines a boxing game and a football kicker in one PRO-GAMES machine with LED lighting. The top Start button releases the punchball for a strength test, and the bottom button starts the kicking game. Compare its published dimensions and finishes with Double Hit to choose the right machine for your space.
boxer-flash-gift: Boxer Flash Gift pairs the classic punching-strength test with the chance to win prizes. Bright LED lighting and engaging gameplay draw attention and encourage players to have a go.
matte-airbrushed: Matte Airbrushed is part of the PRO-GAMES boxing machine range. This page shows matte black airbrushed cabinet designs for the Standard, Combat and Double Hit models, which you can name in your quote request. Sales confirms the technical requirements and final equipment.
boxer-flash: Boxer Flash is a premium PRO-GAMES boxing machine offered in the finishes shown on this page. Compare the photos, choose a colour for your enquiry and ask for the current technical sheet before planning the installation.
kids-basketball: Kids Basketball is a basketball arcade game for children from the PRO-GAMES distributed range. Before ordering, ask sales to confirm the manufacturer, technical documentation, available version and support terms.
kiddie-ride: Kiddie Ride is a ride for young children from the PRO-GAMES distributed range. See the photo and ask sales to confirm the manufacturer, the current range, technical documentation and support before you order.
cyberdart: Cyberdart is an electronic dart machine distributed by PRO-GAMES. Sales will confirm its manufacturer, the current model, technical documentation and support terms before your order.

joker: Joker es una máquina de boxeo de la colección Boxer Standard de PRO-GAMES, decorada con naipes y un inquietante payaso (Bad Clown). Los jugadores golpean el saco para batir la mejor puntuación, un reto de fuerza que hace que los clientes vuelvan.
pow-boxer: POW Boxer lleva el pop art del cómic a la colección Boxer Standard, con un gran rótulo POW! sobre un mueble amarillo. Cada golpe es una prueba de fuerza que invita a volver y mejorar el resultado.
champion: Champion viste el mueble Boxer Standard con un tema de combate por el título: cinturón de campeón, llamas y gráficos de barras y estrellas. Los jugadores golpean el saco e intentan superar la mejor puntuación.
easy: Easy es el diseño clásico de boxeo de la gama Boxer Standard de PRO-GAMES, con siluetas de boxeadores y un llamativo rótulo BOXER. El juego es sencillo: golpea el saco, mira la puntuación y vuelve a jugar para superarla.

mma: MMA es una máquina de boxeo Boxer Standard inspirada en las artes marciales mixtas, con un luchador en rojo y negro. Un golpe fuerte, la puntuación al instante y las ganas de superarla: un juego sencillo que mantiene a los clientes jugando.
black-jack: Black Jack aporta un tema de casino a la colección Boxer Standard: palos de la baraja, naipes y dados cubren el mueble. Detrás del diseño está el probado juego de boxeo de PRO-GAMES: golpear el saco, ver la puntuación y volver a intentarlo.
super-hero: Super Hero decora la máquina Boxer Standard con un superhéroe de cómic con capa y viñetas de colores. Los jugadores golpean el saco para demostrar su fuerza y vuelven para mejorar su marca.
power-black: Power Black es el diseño más oscuro de la colección Boxer Standard: un mueble negro con un luchador musculoso en blanco y negro. Ofrece el mismo reto de fuerza que anima a jugar otra ronda.
poison-squad: Poison Squad cubre el mueble Boxer Standard de verde tóxico, con un soldado con máscara de gas en el centro. Un golpe al saco muestra la puntuación y la invitación a superarla.
hacker: Hacker da a esta máquina de boxeo Boxer Standard un estilo digital: un hacker con capucha rodeado de líneas de neón. El juego sigue siendo clásico: golpear, puntuar y volver para batir el resultado.
strongman: Strongman es un diseño Boxer Standard protagonizado por un forzudo musculoso sobre un mueble amarillo. Invita a medir la fuerza del golpe, comparar puntuaciones y volver a por más.
viking: Viking muestra a un guerrero con casco de cuernos sobre un mueble azul de la colección Boxer Standard. Los jugadores se enfrentan al saco y vuelven para mejorar su resultado.
disco: Disco aporta un ambiente de club a la gama Boxer Standard, con un gráfico festivo y el rótulo de neón DISCO. Los clientes ponen a prueba su golpe y compiten por la puntuación más alta.
boxer-combat: Boxer Combat es una máquina de boxeo premium de PRO-GAMES con mueble rojo enmarcado por luces LED y gráficos BOXING FIGHT TONIGHT. Su juego de fuerza mantiene la competición y hace que los jugadores vuelvan.

black-jack: Black Jack bringt ein Casino-Motiv in die Boxer-Standard-Kollektion: Kartenfarben, Spielkarten und Würfel bedecken das Gehäuse. Dahinter steckt das bewährte Boxspiel von PRO-GAMES – zuschlagen, Punktzahl ablesen, noch einmal versuchen.
super-hero: Super Hero schmückt den Boxer-Standard-Automaten mit einem Comic-Superhelden im Umhang und bunten Comic-Panels. Die Spieler schlagen zu, um ihre Kraft zu zeigen, und kommen wieder, um ihren Wert zu verbessern.

poison-squad: Poison Squad taucht das Boxer-Standard-Gehäuse in giftiges Grün, mit einem Soldaten mit Gasmaske im Mittelpunkt. Ein Schlag auf den Ball zeigt die Punktzahl – und die Einladung, sie zu übertreffen.

strongman: Strongman ist ein Boxer-Standard-Design rund um einen muskelbepackten Kraftmenschen auf gelbem Gehäuse. Es lädt dazu ein, die Schlagkraft zu messen, Ergebnisse zu vergleichen und wiederzukommen.
viking: Viking zeigt einen Krieger mit Hörnerhelm auf einem blauen Gehäuse der Boxer-Standard-Kollektion. Die Spieler nehmen es mit dem Boxball auf und kehren zurück, um ihr Ergebnis zu verbessern.
